card.text: A-type star 19.6 parsecs away with an edge-on debris disc and three imaged giant planets.

sources.label: Sutlieff et al. 2026
sources.quote: We report the direct imaging discovery of a third exoplanet in the beta Pictoris system

introduction.text: Beta Pictoris is a young A-type star 19.6 parsecs away, seen through its own edge-on disc of dust. Its planet b is the first exoplanet heard in radio.

sources.label: Ortiz Ceballos et al. 2026
sources.quote: the first direct detection of auroral radio emission from an exoplanet (beta Pictoris b), with the MeerKAT array

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: The colour of Gaia's spectrum of the star. No surface picture exists.

debris-disc.title: Debris disc, 2.1 and 4.1 µm
debris-disc.summary: The edge-on disc of dust in its contrast to the star, from two JWST filters. Its depth is reconstructed from the image.

sources.label: MAST JWST programme 4758, NIRCam coronagraph mosaics in two filters

debris-disc-visible.title: Debris disc, visible light
debris-disc-visible.summary: The edge-on disc 16 to 82 au out, where planet d orbits, in visible light. Its depth is reconstructed from the image.

sources.label: Ren et al. (2023), HST/STIS image of the disc, VizieR J/A+A/672/A114

debris-disc-colour.title: Debris disc, colour
debris-disc-colour.summary: The edge-on disc 29 to 135 au out in three Hubble filters, in its colour against the star. Its depth is reconstructed.

sources.label: HST programme 9987, ACS/HRC coronagraph images in three filters, starlight removed here
